title: Protected CMS page loading is shadowed by the public slug route
preconditions: Verified Power Admin and an existing CMS page
steps_to_reproduce: 1) List pages; 2) note numeric ID; 3) GET /api/cms/pages/1; 4) select page in UI
expected_result: Protected controller returns editable page and sections
actual_result: Earlier public slug route handles numeric ID and returns 404; editor cannot load
evidence: List 200; item 404; both /1 and /home resolve to PublicCmsController@show
impact: Central CMS workflow is blocked
suggested_fix_direction: Separate or constrain public/protected routes and add route plus E2E tests

title: Power Admin visual edit mode omits most required editing capabilities
requirement: REQ-065 through REQ-073; REQ-077 through REQ-084
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Activate Edit site; 2) try inline selection; 3) open CMS; 4) inspect editing controls
expected_result: Complete inline rich-text/media/button/menu/page/section/lifecycle/version editing
actual_result: Toggle only opens links; editor has limited page/section heading-text operations
evidence: App.tsx and CmsEditorPage source plus runtime edit toggle
impact: Principal visual CMS requirement is substantially absent
suggested_fix_direction: Implement the complete safe component/editor schema and end-to-end workflows

title: Published navigation and theme settings do not affect the public site
location: CMS settings APIs; App.tsx Layout; app.css
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Inspect settings APIs; 2) inspect Layout/CSS; 3) load public page; 4) compare stored value
expected_result: Published settings drive public navigation/theme
actual_result: Layout and colors are hard-coded and public-settings is never fetched
impact: Settings can appear published without changing the site
suggested_fix_direction: Connect validated published settings to renderer and add guarded management/tests

title: Booking API accepts unavailable times and unsupported consultation methods
preconditions: Isolated database with normal rules and service online_available=false
steps_to_reproduce: 1) POST Saturday 03:00; 2) observe 201; 3) POST Breast Surgery online; 4) observe 201
expected_result: Submission must match a generated slot and service/method rules
actual_result: Both invalid requests were accepted
impact: Unavailable or unsupported appointments can be created
suggested_fix_direction: Validate through one server-side availability decision at submission

title: Potential data-integrity finding: appointment overlap prevention is not concurrency-safe
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Review transaction; 2) observe exists check; 3) observe unlocked insert; 4) analyze concurrent interleaving
expected_result: Only one overlapping request can commit
actual_result: Check-then-insert has a race window and no lock or database interval constraint; no simultaneous exploit was run
evidence: Controller lines 31-36; service lines 47-49; schema; no load exploit attempted
impact: Concurrent requests could double-book despite green sequential tests
suggested_fix_direction: Serialize scheduling or enforce database overlap invariant; test on PostgreSQL

title: Configured slot length is ignored during availability generation
preconditions: Rule slot_minutes differs from duration plus buffer
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Configure slot_minutes; 2) select differing service; 3) request slots; 4) compare starts
expected_result: Configured fields have defined scheduling behavior
actual_result: Step uses duration + buffer; slot_minutes is unused
impact: Staff configuration can yield unexpected schedules
suggested_fix_direction: Define slot_minutes semantics and implement or remove/rename it

title: Declined cancellation requests cannot be resubmitted and display the wrong state
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Request cancellation; 2) decline; 3) resubmit with new reason; 4) refresh
expected_result: New pending request or clear rule; accurate declined state
actual_result: Old declined row/reason returned 201; UI says Cancellation requested and hides action
evidence: Isolated request id 1 stayed declined; firstOrCreate; PortalPage condition
impact: Patient cannot recover or understand current state
suggested_fix_direction: Model repeatable requests or reset declined state and render all decisions

title: Rescheduling never records or displays the required Rescheduled state
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Reschedule; 2) retrieve; 3) compare required status; 4) inspect transitions
expected_result: Moved appointment accurately represents Rescheduled
actual_result: Method saves status Confirmed; defined Rescheduled status is terminal and unused
impact: Reporting/filtering/audit semantics diverge from requirements
suggested_fix_direction: Define event vs durable state and align transitions/API/UI

title: Operational calendar is a date-range list rather than the required full calendar
requirement: REQ-053; REQ-055; REQ-059; REQ-095 through REQ-099; REQ-137
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Open calendar; 2) switch views; 3) inspect agenda/grid/actions/filters; 4) inspect availability UI
expected_result: Complete responsive day/week/month/agenda calendar with operations and filters
actual_result: Range buttons change an event list; no agenda/grid/create/edit/drag/filter; recurring rules absent from UI
impact: Staff cannot perform promised schedule management
suggested_fix_direction: Implement accessible calendar operations/filters with server conflict validation

title: Online consultation is a workflow shell with no live media provider
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Check capabilities; 2) enter workflow; 3) check readiness/room; 4) identify provider
expected_result: Related users complete a live authenticated consultation
actual_result: State/signed shell exists but provider is unconfigured and live_video=false
evidence: Provider binding; capability response; MASTER_PLAN lines 176-190
impact: Product cannot deliver online consultation
suggested_fix_direction: Approve/configure provider adapter and run privacy/access/media/device acceptance

title: Unknown and Contact routes silently render the homepage
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Open /contact; 2) observe Home; 3) open invalid path; 4) observe Home/200
expected_result: Contact page for /contact and helpful 404 for invalid path
actual_result: Both paths render Home without error
evidence: IAB route sweep; App.tsx nested wildcard
impact: Broken links are masked and soft 404s can be indexed
suggested_fix_direction: Add explicit Contact and dedicated 404 routes

title: Required public professional, service, education and publication journeys are incomplete
requirement: REQ-003 through REQ-011; REQ-059; REQ-107; REQ-108
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Browse all content routes; 2) seek career/achievements/contact; 3) inspect services/education/publications; 4) open details/DOI
expected_result: Complete sourced navigable public journeys
actual_result: Multiple areas missing; CMS Services hides cards; no education/publication detail, sort, pagination, DOI/source links
evidence: IAB route sweep and frontend source
impact: Polished surface omits material information and credibility workflows
suggested_fix_direction: Complete verified models/routes and test list-filter-detail-link journeys

title: Research publishing state can diverge from public publication state
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Publish; 2) decide rejected; 3) inspect Publication; 4) compare filters
expected_result: Controlled lifecycle retracts rejected info and all feeds agree
actual_result: Code permits a published claim to be rejected without record retraction; filters disagree; nullable DOI upsert is unsafe
evidence: Controller/query/schema evidence; publish/reject mutation not run because the charter prohibits publishing content
impact: Rejected/stale content could remain public and records can diverge
suggested_fix_direction: Use constrained transactional state machine with explicit retract and stable unique identity

title: Seed publications bypass the verification queue and lack bibliographic metadata
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Seed; 2) inspect Publications; 3) inspect queue; 4) compare rows
expected_result: All research seed material is sourced and reviewed before Publication creation
actual_result: Six title-only Publication rows are inserted directly; matching sourced claims can create more rows
evidence: DatabaseSeeder lines 52-71; sampled titles externally verified
impact: Rows are not reviewable through queue and duplicate/incomplete data can result
suggested_fix_direction: Seed ResearchClaim only and create Publications in controlled publish transaction

title: Required patient, account and role administration is absent
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Search patient; 2) try create/edit/deactivate; 3) try manage staff; 4) try role change
expected_result: Authorized patient/account/role management with audit
actual_result: Only patient search/read context exists; no CRUD/account/role routes or UI
impact: Core administration and audit trail cannot be performed
suggested_fix_direction: Add minimum-necessary policy-protected admin workflows with re-auth and before/after audit

title: Native patient app is read-mostly and omits core required actions
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Open core screens; 2) try mutations/transfers; 3) seek reminders/devices; 4) inspect v1 routes
expected_result: Core mobile patient journeys are actionable
actual_result: Screens are read-only; v1 only reads plus cancellation and disabled push
impact: Android/iOS scope is not fulfilled
suggested_fix_direction: Add versioned mutations/native flows with idempotency privacy and device tests

title: Native app offers cancellation for server-ineligible appointment states
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Load appointment; 2) observe cancel button; 3) submit; 4) observe rejection
expected_result: Only permitted actions are shown
actual_result: Button appears for multiple ineligible states
evidence: Native status exclusion list vs server policy
impact: Predictable failed action in sensitive workflow
suggested_fix_direction: Expose and render server-derived allowed actions

title: Mobile public navigation toggle is non-functional
location: Public header below 992 px; App.tsx; main.tsx
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Load at 390 px; 2) confirm collapsed links; 3) activate toggle; 4) inspect visibility/state
expected_result: Menu opens/closes and exposes links with accessible state
actual_result: #nav remains hidden; class unchanged; aria-expanded absent; Bootstrap JS/state missing
evidence: IAB 390 px; App.tsx lines 33-35; main.tsx CSS-only import
impact: Most public navigation is unreachable on phones
suggested_fix_direction: Implement controlled React disclosure and test all widths/keyboard/touch

title: Form labeling, skip navigation and focus treatment are incomplete
location: Auth booking portal staff CMS and academic forms; app.css
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Inspect sign-in names; 2) tab for skip link; 3) focus patient search; 4) inspect placeholder-only fields
expected_result: Programmatic labels visible focus skip path and announced errors/status
actual_result: Unnamed sign-in controls; many placeholder-only fields; no skip link; search outline removed; no live-region strategy
evidence: IAB sign-in DOM and source/CSS review
impact: Control purpose focus and results may be unclear
suggested_fix_direction: Adopt associated labels/errors skip link focus-visible and announced status components

title: Several small-text color combinations fail WCAG AA contrast
location: Design tokens; booking progress; rose labels
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Read colors; 2) calculate contrast; 3) compare 4.5:1; 4) inspect uses
expected_result: Normal text meets 4.5:1
actual_result: Rose/ivory is 4.17:1; rose/#fff8f4 4.21:1; inactive/white 2.81:1
impact: Low-vision users may struggle with progress/context labels
suggested_fix_direction: Use verified AA semantic text tokens and contrast regression checks

title: Potential Security Finding: password reset does not revoke active browser sessions
preconditions: Active browser session and completed reset
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Inspect reset callback; 2) note credential change; 3) note tokens deleted; 4) note sessions retained
expected_result: Reset terminates all other sessions/tokens
actual_result: API tokens are deleted but no browser database-session invalidation is implemented
evidence: ResetPasswordController lines 22-25; database session driver; two-session exploit test not performed
impact: Compromised browser session may survive reset
suggested_fix_direction: Invalidate other sessions and provide audited device/session revocation

title: Upload pipeline is not protected by a production-grade malware scanner
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Inspect binding; 2) inspect scanner; 3) note 8 KB/four signatures; 4) review release note
expected_result: Approved monitored malware analysis gates uploads
actual_result: Default is a simple signature boundary, not malware analysis
impact: Malicious content can pass simplistic checks into sensitive storage
suggested_fix_direction: Quarantine and fail closed through approved scanner before release

title: Audit logging omits required actions and consistent before/after values
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Inventory writers; 2) compare required events; 3) inspect metadata; 4) compare role operations
expected_result: Complete actor/action/resource/time and before/after coverage
actual_result: Uploads/downloads messages consultation actions and role changes have gaps; metadata inconsistent
impact: Incident/privacy/accountability investigations have blind spots
suggested_fix_direction: Define event catalogue and safe metadata schema; assert each mutation log

title: Multiple asynchronous UI failures have no user-visible recovery path
location: Portal staff calendar and CMS actions
preconditions: API validation authorization or network error
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Inspect mutation handlers; 2) force/reason about rejection; 3) find catches; 4) find recovery/focus
expected_result: Every failure explains and supports recovery
actual_result: Many awaited mutations lack catch/onError and render no failure state
impact: Users can lose context or believe sensitive action succeeded
suggested_fix_direction: Shared mutation/error pattern with field errors retry focus and announcements

title: Public routes use one static metadata set and lack canonical/social discovery metadata
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Load routes; 2) inspect title/description; 3) inspect canonical/OG; 4) inspect sitemap
expected_result: Per-route metadata and sitemap
actual_result: One title/description; no canonical/OG/sitemap
impact: Poor search/social representation and amplified soft-404 risk
suggested_fix_direction: Add route/CMS metadata canonical/OG and published-page sitemap

title: Frontend loads global data and all route modules eagerly
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Inspect imports/queries; 2) inspect public requests; 3) inspect auth/staff bundle; 4) build
expected_result: Routes load necessary code/data only
actual_result: Synchronous imports; global public query; public me probe; JS 405.45 KB/124.93 KB gzip
impact: Avoidable download execution and requests on mobile networks
suggested_fix_direction: Lazy-load route groups and scope queries; enforce performance budget

title: Privacy, Terms and Accessibility footer labels are not links
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Scroll footer; 2) activate Privacy; 3) activate Terms/Accessibility; 4) inspect DOM
expected_result: Labels link to complete approved pages
actual_result: Plain text only
impact: Expected health-product policy information is not reachable
suggested_fix_direction: Create approved pages and real accessible links

title: Appointment booking omits the required document attachment step
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Select service/method; 2) choose slot; 3) reach details; 4) inspect file control/API
expected_result: Allowed document attaches securely to request
actual_result: No file control and API accepts no attachment
impact: Required referral/report needs separate manual exchange
suggested_fix_direction: Design quarantined/scanned pre-registration attachment with ownership/retention

title: Patients have no reschedule request workflow
location: Web portal; self appointment APIs; mobile app
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Open web appointment; 2) seek reschedule; 3) repeat native; 4) inspect self routes
expected_result: Patient requests a new time subject to approval/availability
actual_result: Only cancellation exists; staff alone can directly reschedule
impact: Patients must leave platform for time changes
suggested_fix_direction: Add reschedule-request lifecycle with eligible slots staff decision audit and notifications
